title: H-ARTIN-SCHREIER-DELIGNE: Exact Deligne-Weil Spectral Bounds over Cyclotomic Ring Z[zeta_q]
author: Antigravity (ExactQuantumNumericsMind v1.0, eqn-mix)

H-ASD-1.statement: Linear additive characters sum to zero identically in Z[zeta_q]
H-ASD-1.polynomials: f(x) = a*x mod q, a in GF(q)*
H-ASD-1.falsification_condition: Any non-zero element in cyclotomic basis

H-ASD-2.statement: Quadratic Gauss sums saturate Deligne-Weil bound |S(x^2)|^2 = q * 1 bit-identically

H-ASD-3.statement: Cubic Weierstrass sums satisfy Deligne bound |sigma_k(S(x^3+ax))|^2 <= 4q across all Galois embeddings
H-ASD-3.polynomials: f(x) = x^3 + a*x mod q, a in {0, 1, 2}

H-ASD-4.statement: Artin-Schreier unitary quantum propagator ground-state projection |<0|W_f|0>| <= d - 1
H-ASD-4.falsification_condition: Any embedding violating spectral projection bound

methodology.algebra: Canonical cyclotomic ring Z[x]/(Phi_q(x)), rank q-1
methodology.exactness: G2-EXAKT (stdlib-only, zero floating point arithmetic on values, zero RNG)
